description: Use this when the user wants Tenda to rewrite one answer in a bid it drafted, e.g. "make Q3 shorter" or "use the Glasgow contract as the example in 2.1". Tenda rewrites it in the background, marks it again and says when it's done. A bid's first ten rewrites are included; after that each uses a little of the workspace's allowance. Needs a Tenda account. Do not use before the draft is ready.

draft_id.description: The draft's ID, from start_bid_draft. Or give the tender's reference instead, or neither for the workspace's latest draft.

instruction.description: What to change, in the user's words.

question.description: The answer to rewrite, by the buyer's number, e.g. "Q3".

tender_reference.description: The notice ID, procurement identifier, solicitation number or the buyer's own reference, e.g. "012345-2026" on Find a Tender, "WS4851234567" on CanadaBuys or "140D0427Q0879" on SAM.gov.

workspace.description: The Tenda workspace to use, by name, when the user is in more than one, e.g. "Northbridge Services".

name: rewrite_bid_answer

step.description: questions, team, plan, write, mark, revise or ready; stopped when drafting stopped.

stepsDone.description: Steps done of steps: all of them once it's ready.

title: Have Tenda rewrite an answer
